descriptions.normal: A grilled steak. High heat has locked the juices in, giving one high expectations for when the meat is cut open.
descriptions.suspicious: A grilled steak. Its color is a little bleak, almost as if it feels sorry for itself for being a sorry excuse for a steak.
descriptions.delicious: A grilled steak. Juicy, flavorsome, fragrant steak. One bite and you feel yourself come alive.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 100 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 50 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 150 HP.
